headline.caveat: $8B (2023–24, largely convertible notes) + $5B (Apr 2026, at ~$380B valuation), plus up to $20B of additional milestone-tied commitments not yet counted

nature_md: Amazon's Anthropic position built in layers: $1.25B (Sept 2023) growing to $4B (Mar 2024), +$4B (Nov 2024) = $8B, then +$5B on Apr 20, 2026 at Anthropic's ~$380B valuation with up to $20B more tied to commercial milestones — all as a non-voting minority holder, and always paired with compute: the 2024 tranches came with Trainium adoption and Project Rainier, the 2026 tranche with the >$100B decade-long AWS commitment and up to 5GW of Trainium (see related edge). The position now dominates Amazon's reported earnings: Q2 2026 included a **$53.4B pre-tax non-operating fair-value gain** 'primarily from our investments in Anthropic' (after Anthropic's May 2026 Series H at $965B post), nearly 2x Amazon's $27.5B operating income that quarter, plus $15.9B of H1 discrete tax expense from the markups.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Originally convertible notes, now equity interests carried at fair value: private-round marks flow through Amazon's non-operating income — the Q2 2026 $53.4B gain is non-cash, non-recurring, and set by private funding-round prices, not markets. It dwarfed operating profit, making Amazon's headline net income substantially an Anthropic derivative.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Equity/convertible financing — no revenue. Proceeds substantially fund AWS compute purchases that Amazon books as revenue and backlog: the paired structure means Amazon's investment and AWS's largest-customer growth are the same money at one remove.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** a textbook Einhorn cascade — Amazon invests, the money returns as AWS revenue, and the private-mark gain ($53.4B, priced by rounds in which strategic buyers participate) flatters net income with paper profits on an asset that can't be sold (Q2-26 gain ≈ 2x operating income). **Bull:** Anthropic's run-rate went $9B→$30B+ in under a year — the marks track real revenue; the Series H was priced by third parties; and unlike pure paper, Amazon's return includes hard consideration: Trainium validation, 5GW of anchored demand, and the largest committed customer in AWS history.

observations.metric_label: Amazon pre-tax fair-value gain, primarily Anthropic
observations.notes: Non-operating, non-cash; H1 2026 also carried $15.9B of net discrete tax expense primarily from upward Anthropic adjustments.
